main_body: sci-fi building with sloped metal roof and front facade
top_band: light blue-grey panelled roof surface with rooftop vents from row 1 to row 17
evidence: Rows 1-17 show a clear foreshortened top/sloped roof surface with rooftop vents in 3/4 view, bordered by a light grey front edge line at row 17, a shadowed fascia/trim (rows 18-21), and the vertical front wall with inset windows and door from rows 21-44.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, finely textured Beodeul houses, the candidate uses large flat colour fills on the roof panels, windows, and wall sections, has pure black outlines along the roof edges, and has much lower colour/detail density per tile.
